notes.itemTitle: Submit the visa application at TLS Contact
notes.title: Dossier can move to India
notes.text: Campus France Indonesia confirmed this morning that they can transfer your dossier to New Delhi, so you can continue the France-Visas application from India. You have written to Delhi asking what they need from your side. - Ask Fitria to start the transfer from her end rather than waiting for Delhi to describe it.

notes.itemTitle: Close the KITAS and withdraw BPJS
notes.title: Locus asked to approve
notes.text: You asked Ravi and Jishnu this morning to approve proceeding with InCorp's revised quote. The exit now waits on Locus rather than on you or InCorp. - Give them the date: anything agreed after late October leaves no room before 8 November.
